arxiv-2008-12459.title: Layoffs, Inequity and COVID-19: A Longitudinal Study of the Journalism Jobs Crisis in Australia from 2012 to 2020
arxiv-2008-12459.creator: Nik Dawson \affilnum 1 \affilnum 2, Sacha Molitorisz \affilnum 3, Marian-Andrei Rizoiu \affilnum 4 and Peter Fray \affilnum 5
arxiv-2008-12459.description: Abstract In Australia and beyond, journalism is reportedly an industry in crisis, a crisis exacerbated by COVID-19. However, the evidence revealing the crisis is often anecdotal or limited in scope. In this unprecedented longitudinal research, we draw on data from the Australian journalism jobs market from January 2012 until March 2020.

arxiv-2206-00768.title: Unruh quantum Otto engine in the presence of a reflecting boundary
arxiv-2206-00768.creator: Arnab Mukherjee, Sunandan Gangopadhyay, A. S. Majumdar
arxiv-2206-00768.description: Abstract We introduce a new model of relativistic quantum analogue of the classical Otto engine in the presence of a perfectly reflecting boundary. A single qubit acts as the working substance interacting with a massless quantum scalar field, with the boundary obeying the Dirichlet condition. The quantum vacuum serves as a thermal bath through the Unruh effect.

arxiv-2208-04326.title: Incorporating baryon-driven contraction of dark matter halos in rotation curve fits
arxiv-2208-04326.creator: Pengfei Li ,, Stacy S. McGaugh, Federico Lelli, James M. Schombert, Marcel S. Pawlowski
arxiv-2208-04326.description: Abstract The condensation of baryons within a dark matter (DM) halo during galaxy formation should result in some contraction of the halo as the combined system settles into equilibrium. We quantify this effect on the cuspy primordial halos predicted by DM-only simulations for the baryon distributions observed in the galaxies of the SPARC database.

arxiv-2211-13290.title: SEAT: Stable and Explainable Attention
arxiv-2211-13290.creator: Lijie Hu, Yixin Liu, Ninghao Liu, Mengdi Huai, Lichao Sun, Di Wang
arxiv-2211-13290.description: Abstract Currently, attention mechanism becomes a standard fixture in most state-of-the-art natural language processing (NLP) models, not only due to outstanding performance it could gain, but also due to plausible innate explanation for the behaviors of neural architectures it provides, which is notoriously difficult to analyze.

arxiv-2303-13881.title: Symbolic Music Structure Analysis with Graph Representations and Changepoint Detection Methods
arxiv-2303-13881.creator: Carlos Hernandez-Olivan, Sonia Rubio Llamas, and Jose R. Beltran
arxiv-2303-13881.description: Abstract Music Structure Analysis is an open research task in Music Information Retrieval (MIR). In the past, there have been several works that attempt to segment music into the audio and symbolic domains, however, the identification and segmentation of the music structure at different levels is still an open research problem in this area.

arxiv-2310-03516.title: The discrete horospherical p p -Minkowski problem in hyperbolic space
arxiv-2310-03516.creator: Haizhong Li, Yao Wan, Botong Xu
arxiv-2310-03516.description:
A 2023 arXiv research paper by Haizhong Li, Yao Wan, Botong Xu. In [ 19 ] , the first author and the third author introduced and studied the horospherical p p -Minkowski problem for smooth horospherically convex domains in hyperbolic space. In this paper, we introduce and solve the discrete horospherical p p -Minkowski problem in hyperbolic space for all p ∈ ( − ∞ , + ∞ ) p\in(-\infty,+\infty) when the given measure is even on the unit sphere. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification
52A55; 52A20

arxiv-2401-12443.title: Patch2QL: Discover Cognate Defects in Open Source Software Supply Chain With Auto-generated Static Analysis Rules
arxiv-2401-12443.creator: Fuwei Wang, Yongzhi Liu, Zhiqiang Dong
arxiv-2401-12443.description: Abstract In the open source software (OSS) ecosystem, there exists a complex software supply chain, where developers upstream and downstream widely borrow and reuse code. This results in the widespread occurrence of recurring defects, missing fixes, and propagation issues. These are collectively referred to as cognate defects, and their scale and threats have not received extensive attention and systematic research.

arxiv-2412-19499.title: Tailoring Robust Quantum Anomalous Hall Effect via Entropy-Engineering
arxiv-2412-19499.creator: Syeda Amina Shabbir, Frank Fei Yun, Muhammad Nadeem, Xiaolin Wang
arxiv-2412-19499.description: Abstract The development of quantum materials and the tailoring of their functional properties is of fundamental interest in materials science. Here, a new design concept is proposed for the robust quantum anomalous Hall effect via entropy engineering in 2D magnets.

arxiv-2501-08795.title: Heat transfer simulation of window frames with SPHinXsys
arxiv-2501-08795.creator: Haotian Ji, Dong Wu, Chi Zhang, Xiangyu Hu
arxiv-2501-08795.description: Abstract Maintaining a comfortable temperature inside a building requires appropriate thermal insulation of windows, which can be optimised iteratively with numerical simulation. Smoothed particle hydrodynamics(SPH) is a fully Lagrangian method widely used for simulating multi-physics applications with high computational efficiency and accuracy. It is advantageous in physically coupled problems such as heat-fluid-solid or any other type of physically coupled simulations.

arxiv-2503-14752.title: Triplets of Mutually Unbiased Bases
arxiv-2503-14752.creator: Máte Matolcsi, Ákos K. Matszangosz, Dániel Varga, Mihály Weiner
arxiv-2503-14752.description: Abstract . We initiate a systematic study of triplets of mutually unbiased bases (MUBs). We show that each MUB-triplet in ℂ d \mathbb{C}^{d} is characterized by a d × d × d d\times d\times d object that we call a Hadamard cube .

arxiv-2510-21639.title: Near-Optimal Min-Sum Multi-Robot Motion Planning in a Planar Polygonal Environment
arxiv-2510-21639.creator: Pankaj K. Agarwal, Benjamin Holmgren, Alex Steiger
arxiv-2510-21639.description: Abstract Let 𝒲 ⊂ ℝ 2 \mathscr{W}\subset\mathbb{R}^{2} be a planar polygonal environment with n n vertices, and let [ k ] = { 1 , … , k } [k]=\{1,\ldots,k\} denote k k unit-square robots translating in 𝒲 \mathscr{W} .

arxiv-2511-10906.title: In situ Evidence of 5-minute Oscillations from Parker Solar Probe
arxiv-2511-10906.creator: Zesen Huang, Marco Velli, Olga Panasenco, Richard J. Morton, Chen Shi, Yeimy J. Rivera, Benjamin Chandran, Samuel T. Badman, Yuliang Ding, Nour Raouafi, Stuart D. Bale, Michael Stevens, Tamar Ervin, Chuanpeng Hou, Kristopher G. Klein, Orlando Romeo, Jia Huang, Mingzhe Liu, Davin E Larson Marc Pulupa
arxiv-2511-10906.description: Abstract The Sun’s surface vibrates in characteristic 5-minute oscillations, known as p -modes, generated by sound waves trapped within the convection zone. Although these oscillations have long been hypothesized to reach into the solar wind, direct in situ evidence has remained elusive, even during previous close encounters by Parker Solar Probe (PSP).

pmc-11375382.title: Self-Administered Interventions Based on Natural Language Processing Models for Reducing Depressive and Anxiety Symptoms: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-11375382.creator: David Villarreal-Zegarra, C Mahony Reategui-Rivera, Jackeline García-Serna, Gleni Quispe-Callo, Gabriel Lázaro-Cruz, Gianfranco Centeno-Terrazas, Ricardo Galvez-Arevalo, Stefan Escobar-Agreda, Alejandro Dominguez-Rodriguez, Joseph Finkelstein, John Torous, Yichuan Liu, Shuo Zhang
pmc-11375382.description: BackgroundThe introduction of natural language processing (NLP) technologies has significantly enhanced the potential of self-administered interventions for treating anxiety and depression by improving human-computer interactions. Although these advances, particularly in complex models such as generative artificial intelligence (AI), are highly promising, robust evidence validating the effectiveness of the interventions remains sparse.

pmc-11513537.title: Limiting 20S proteasome assembly leads to unbalanced nucleo-cytoplasmic distribution of 26S/30S proteasomes and chronic proteotoxicity
pmc-11513537.creator: Gabriel Ruiz-Romero, María Dolores Berdún, Mark Hochstrasser, Silvia Salas-Pino, Rafael R Daga
pmc-11513537.description: SummaryIn addition to the degradation of cell-cycle proteins, short-lived, damaged, or unfolded proteins are constantly cleared from cells by the proteasome. During proliferation, the proteasome localizes to the nucleus and cytoplasm; however, the functional relevance of this compartmentalization remains unclear.

pmc-11607955.title: Comparative genomics and virulence potential of Campylobacter coli strains isolated from different sources over 25 years in Brazil
pmc-11607955.creator: Carolina Nogueira Gomes, Andrei Giacchetto Felice, Giovana do Nascimento Pereira, Victor Augusto Sallum Ceballos, Siomar de Castro Soares, Ludmilla Tonani, Patrícia Helena Grizante Barião, Márcia Regina von Zeska Kress, Sheila da Silva Duque, Maria Balkey, Marc William Allard, Juliana Pfrimer Falcão
pmc-11607955.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundCampylobacter spp. have been reported as a common cause of gastroenteritis in humans in many countries. However, in Brazil there is insufficient data to estimate the impact of Campylobacter in public health. In light of the importance of this foodborne pathogen, the aim of this study was to perform comparative analyses on 80 Brazilian Campylobacter coli genomes isolated from human feces, animals, the environment, and food. Methods include Average Nucleotide Identity (ANI), Gegenees, genomic plasticity, presence of pathogenicity, resistance, and metabolic islands.

pmc-12434790.title: Assessment of psychometric properties of instruments for measuring health system literacy: A systematic review study protocol using COSMIN guidelines
pmc-12434790.creator: Anh Thu Vo, Lisa Fang, Lixia Yang, Robin Urquhart, Yanqing Yi, Peizhong Peter Wang
pmc-12434790.description: AbstractIntroductionThe healthcare system is complex, involving multiple interactions among individuals, organisations and systems. Many patients, particularly those with limited health system literacy, struggle to navigate it. A reliable instrument is crucial for accurately measuring individuals’ navigational abilities. However, a systematic review of psychometric properties of existing instruments for measuring health system literacy has not been conducted.

pmc-12750160.title: IGF2BP1 positively regulates CircOGDH accumulation in hypoxia induced stress granules
pmc-12750160.creator: Xuanlin Su, Jiankun Zang, Yaping Wang, Shiqing Zhang, Panwen Wu, Wei Chen, Lei Shi, Yousheng Wu, Die Deng, Kaiwei Cai, Hongcheng Mai, Anding Xu, Dan Lu
pmc-12750160.description: The ischemic penumbra is critical in acute ischemic stroke (AIS) treatment, yet the regulation of precise RNA modification pathways remains unclear. Using a mouse model of ischemic stroke and human postmortem brain samples, we demonstrate that N6-methyladenosine (m6A) levels are elevated in neurons within the ischemic penumbra.

pmc-13385552.title: Clinical heterogeneity of primary cutaneous γδ T-cell lymphoma: a 20-year single-institution experience
pmc-13385552.creator: Miran Han, Sang Eun Yoon, Junhun Cho, Seok Jin Kim, Won Seog Kim
pmc-13385552.description: PurposePrimary cutaneous γδ T-cell lymphoma (PCGDTCL) is a rare cutaneous T-cell lymphoma defined by γδ T-cell receptor expression and a cytotoxic phenotype. It has historically been considered highly aggressive, with median survival of 15–30 months and no standardized treatment due to its rarity. However, emerging reports describe subsets with relatively indolent behavior.
